item.title: Power Outages, Government Debt, Cabbage Beach Vendors
item.ns0:title: Power Outages, Government Debt, Cabbage Beach Vendors
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the local business community is calling for urgent relief as ongoing summer power outages force companies to rely on costly generator power and eat into their profits. A political battle also intensifies as the opposition demands transparency and accountability after the government's debt skyrocketed by 700 million dollars over the previous fiscal year. Meanwhile, Cabbage Beach vendors are standing their ground against a newly erected shoreline fence that threatens their livelihoods, while the Department of Immigration continues its active repatriation exercises with over 100 Haitian nationals sent back home. Plus, our team brings you major developments from the courts on a series of shocking shootings, the latest Bahamian sports triumphs, and your full weekend weather forecast.
